ios.desc:
Award-winning app for your daily workouts! Simple set up, intense workout:
*** One touch to set up Workout, Rest, and Repeat.
*** Supports both iPhone and Apple Watch
*** Colorful design, to give you some eye candy while working hard
*** Multiple timers for easy access and training
*** Premium timers where different fitness types are mixed
*** Background notification, so you can keep working out while browsing other apps, or even when screen is locked
*** Listen to your favorite music while working out
*** See your workout history in calendar view

Health App Integration
We integrate with the health app (HealthKit) to read and track your steps data and show them in a beautiful way.

Feature details:
- Workout duration: 2 seconds to 8 minutes
- Rest duration: 0 seconds to 8 minutes
- Repeat: 20 times (50 times if purchased Premium Subscription)
- Premium timers: mix fitness types, including Planks, Jumping Jack, Push Ups, Sit Ups, High Knees, Side Planks, Butt Kicks, Side Lunges, Lunges, etc.
- Multiple timers for quick access
- Name your timers
- Swipe-to-delete timers
- Drag-n-drop to reorder custom timers
- 10 seconds count down, so you can get into workout position
- Count down sound before next workout starts, for you to recover position
- Pause and resume workout at any time
- Reset at any time if workout was interrupted
- Calendar view: shows your work/rest/repeat sessions
- Listen to your favorite music in background, while working out the Interval Timer in foreground
- Background music will be tuned down when playing workout sounds
- Vibration / Haptic feedbacks between workout and rest
- Ability to mute all workout sound

Users say good works after usage:
"I love the simplicity and ease of use of this app. It is almost exactly what I am looking for."
"No frills or gimmicks, this app gives it to you straight, which is how interval timers should work IMO."
"An eye-candy for your tough workouts."
"Mind-blowing on how easy it is to use."
"Simple. Does EXACTLY what you need."

Also checkout our awesome demo video on Youtube:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gO_z8mN1asU

Interval Timer Pro (In App Purchase):
- Create unlimited number of timers for easy access
- Use our premium timers
- Repeat workout for more than 20 times

• You can subscribe for Interval Timer Pro inside the app; subscriptions are billed monthly or annually at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan.
